findings.description: At 360 px wide the expenses table is about 760 px wide inside a container with overflow: clip, so the Amount and Actions columns (including Edit and Delete) are cut off and cannot be scrolled to. Phone users cannot see the amounts or reach the row actions.
repro: Sign in as editor-d06b at a 360 px wide viewport
Observe the table is clipped after the Category column; Amount and Actions are not visible and there is no horizontal scroll

findings.description: Every row has a Delete button and an Edit link with identical names and no row context, so screen reader users hearing the list cannot tell which expense each action affects.
repro: Navigate the Actions column with a screen reader or the accessibility tree
Observe all Delete buttons and Edit links have the same names

notes: Tested viewer and editor at 1280 px and 360 px. Totals were correct on the full list, the travel filter and after adding an expense. Viewer is blocked from /expenses/new and /expenses/1/edit with 403. Not tested: full keyboard-only sweep and automated axe scan. Test data: added one editor expense 'QA test item' ($10.05) during testing.
